verdict.rationale: The github.com/google/google-authenticator repo provides open-source HOTP/TOTP implementations and a PAM module, giving some source visibility, but this covers only server-side/PAM components, not the closed-source mobile Android/iOS apps most users interact with. Missing for 10: no evidence the actual mobile app source is published, no explicit license statement, and no confirmation the repo covers the full product used by end users.
